summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of Agency Docs app (invoice/quotation/proposal/etc). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed (auth, profile, clients CRUD, documents CRUD with line_items/discount/tax, PDF A4+Letter, DOCX, duplicate, convert, mark-paid, status, share public link+PDF, packages, dashboard, exports json/csv, recurring). Frontend: login, dashboard stats, clients CRUD + search, settings, new document flow, document editor (add line item, discount/tax toggles, currency select, save), export menu (PDF A4/Letter/DOCX buttons all present), share button (returns /share/ link), documents list filters, command palette all verified.

issues: React console warning: setState during render (Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering Login) — cosmetic but should be moved into useEffect
Radix warning: DialogContent requires DialogTitle for screen readers. Wrap the CommandDialog title in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle.

action_items: (Optional) Fix React setState-in-render warning on Login page (move side effect into useEffect).
(Optional) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to CommandDialog / other Radix DialogContent to remove a11y warnings.
(Info) Post-login redirect goes to '/' not '/dashboard' — Dashboard is rendered on root route. Route is fine; only note for future test scripts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py handles many concerns (auth, profile, clients, docs, share, export) in one file — consider splitting by domain if it grows past ~700 lines.
PDF/DOCX endpoints correctly return proper mime; share endpoint public routes work without auth as designed.
seed_data_creation: Test client 'TEST_UIClient' and a test invoice document created via UI. TEST_ClientA + line_items/discount/tax invoice created via pytest (some cleaned up in teardown, doc_id not deleted intentionally for reuse).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` (uses pytest-xdist per pytest.ini). Login response is flat (email/id at top level, no nested 'user' key). Dashboard route is '/' after login, not '/dashboard'.
